urgent.heading: Okuphuthumayo - shayela manje
urgent.primary_message: Sebenzisa i-blue reliever inhaler ene-spacer. Uma kungekho ngcono emizuzwini eyi-10 — shayela ku-10177.

what_is_it.heading: Isifuba somoya sobuntwana ngamazwi alula
what_is_it.lede: Isifuba somoya lapho imigudu yomoya emaphashini izwela futhi ivuvukale - iyaqina futhi ikhiqize amafinyila ekuphenduleni izinto ezibangela ukuphefumula, okwenza kube nzima ngengane ukuphefumula.
paragraphs: Isifuba somoya ebuntwaneni singesinye sezifo ezingelapheki ezivame kakhulu ezinganeni zaseNingizimu Afrika - cishe ingane eyodwa kweziyi-10. Izimpawu zingafika zidlule. Ngokwelashwa okufanele, izingane eziningi ezinesifuba somoya zingaphila, zidlale imidlalo, futhi zilale ngendlela evamile.

Izingane ezinesifuba somoya ngokuvamile zidinga izinhlobo ezimbili zemithi: i-reliever inhaler (ngokuvamile eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka) ngesikhathi sokuhlasela, kanye ne- preventer inhaler (evame ukuba nsundu) esetshenziswa nsuku zonke ukugcina imigudu yomoya izolile. Umvikeli yikho ovimba ingane ukuthi iphume esibhedlela - ngisho nalapho izizwa kahle.

items.headline: 1 ku10
items.body: Izingane zaseNingizimu Afrika zinesifuba somoya - eziningi azitholakali, ikakhulukazi lezo ezikhwehlela njalo ebusuku.

items.headline: Ama-inhalers amabili
items.body: I-blue reliever yokuhlaselwa, i-brown preventer nsuku zonke. Umvikeli uyena olawula lesi sifo.

items.headline: Njalo i-spacer
items.body: Izingane kufanele ngaso sonke isikhathi zisebenzise i-spacer nge-inhaler yazo. Iphinda kabili inani lomuthi ofika emaphashini.

items.headline: Izibangeli ziyahlukahluka
items.body: Izimbangela ezivamile: umkhuhlane wegciwane, uthuli, intuthu, isilwane esifuywayo, umoya obandayo, ukuvivinya umzimba. Ukwazi izimbangela zengane yakho kusiza ukuvimbela ukuhlaselwa.

pull_quote.text: Ukuhlaselwa kwesifuba somoya kwezingane okungalungile ngokwanele esibhedlela bekungavinjelwa ngokusetshenziswa kwansuku zonke kwe-inhaler yokuvimbela. Ungakuyeki ngoba ingane izizwa kahle - yilokho okuhloselwe ukukwenza.

signs.heading: Izimpawu ezivamile zesifuba somoya ebuntwaneni
signs.lede: Isifuba somoya asibukeki njengokuphefumula ngaso sonke isikhathi. Ezinganeni ikakhulukazi, ukukhwehlela okomile okuthatha isikhathi eside - ikakhulukazi ebusuku noma lapho uvivinya umzimba - ngokuvamile kuwukuphela kophawu lwezinyanga ngaphambi kokuxilongwa.

items.title: Ukukhwehlela lokho ngeke kuphele
items.description: Ikakhulukazi ebusuku, ekuseni kakhulu, noma ngokugijima nokudlala. Uphawu oluvame kakhulu ezinganeni - ngokuvamile eziphuthelwa izinyanga 'njengomkhuhlane olokhu ubuya'.

items.title: Ukuhefuzela noma ukuphefumula okunomsindo
items.description: Umsindo womlozi, ikakhulukazi uma uphefumulela ngaphandle. Ngezinye izikhathi kuphela ngesikhathi somkhuhlane, ngezinye izikhathi nanoma yikuphi ukuzikhandla.

items.title: Ukuphefumula, isifuba esiqinile
items.description: Ingane ihlala e-PE, ayikwazi ukuhambisana nontanga, ikhononda ukuthi isifuba sizizwa siqinile noma 'sibuhlungu'. Kufanelekile ukuphenywa.

items.myth: Izingane zikhula njalo ngenxa yesifuba somoya.
items.fact: Abaningi bayakwenza—kodwa abaningi abakwenzi. Ngisho nalapho izimpawu seziphelile, ukuzwela kwendlela yokuphefumula kungabuya kunoma iyiphi iminyaka. Gcina isivimbeli siqhubeka njengoba kuyalelwe, noma ngabe kulungile.

Umthamo kuzivimbela ezihogeliwe uphansi kakhulu futhi usebenza endaweni emaphashini. Noma yimuphi umthelela omncane ekukhuleni awunabungozi kakhulu kunesifuba somoya esingalawulwa kahle. I-Oral steroids ngesikhathi sokuhlaselwa inomphumela owengeziwe - yingakho ukuvimbela kubalulekile.

items.myth: Isifuba somoya sisho ukuthi awukho umdlalo.
items.fact: Isifuba somoya esilawulwa kahle akufanele silinganisele ezemidlalo. Abasubathi abaningi bama-Olympic banesifuba somoya. Uma ingane yakho ingakwazi ukuhambisana nontanga, isifuba somoya asilawuleki — khuluma nomtholampilo.
I-reliever eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ingeyezinsuku zokugula. I-blocker ensundu kufanele isetshenziswe nsuku zonke - noma ngabe ilungile. Ukuyeqa kuvumela ukuvuvukala kwakhe, okuholela ekuhlaselweni.

items.title: Thola uhlelo lokusebenza lwe-asthma emtholampilo
items.description: Uhlelo olubhaliwe lukutshela ngqo ukuthi yini okufanele uyenze esigabeni ngasinye - oluhlaza (okuhle), ophuzi (oluba lubi), olubomvu (oluphuthumayo). Kumahhala, kusayinwe udokotela noma unesi wakho.

items.title: Njalo sebenzisa i-spacer nge-inhaler
items.description: Ama-spacers aphinda kabili inani lomuthi ofika emaphashini. Kumahhala emitholampilo. Ungavumeli ingane ukuthi isebenzise i-inhaler ngaphandle kwayo.

items.title: Nikeza okokuvimbela nsuku zonke, njalo ngonyaka
items.description: Isivimbeli esinsundu (noma inhlanganisela ye-inhaler) kabili ngosuku, nsuku zonke. Nalapho ingane izizwa kahle. Ngisho nasehlobo. Ukweqa kuyimbangela evame kakhulu yokuhlaselwa.

items.title: Yazi izimbangela zengane yakho
items.description: Gcina amanothi kulokho okuletha izimpawu. Ezivamile: amagciwane abandayo, uthuli, intuthu (kuhlanganise ne-braai), amakati, izinja, umoya obandayo, ukuzivocavoca. Yehlisa ongakwenza.

items.title: Tshela isikole kanye nokunakekela ngemva kwesikhathi
items.description: Banikeze ikhophi yohlelo lokusebenza kanye ne-spare ye-inhaler enesikhala. Izikole eziningi ziyakwamukela lokhu uma amaphepha esesayiniwe.

get_help.heading: Lapho okumele uye khona
get_help.lede: Isifuba somoya ebuntwaneni siyelapheka ngokugcwele ohlelweni lukahulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika. Ama-inhaler, ama-spacers, nezinhlelo zokusebenza konke kumahhala emitholampilo.
